# Reviewed Web dogfood source boundaries

These files are reduced, reviewed boundaries derived from permissively licensed upstream examples. They are retained only to make the campaign deterministic and offline.

- Upstream repositories are never modified.
- The files are not represented as complete byte-for-byte upstream copies.
- Exact upstream repository, revision, release, path, license, local SHA-256, adapter boundary, and unsupported effects are recorded in `external/web-dogfood-manifests/`.
- Runtime effects outside the finite boundary are reported as descriptor-only diagnostics rather than executed.

The upstream projects remain governed by their respective MIT licenses. Proped's adaptation and campaign code remain under this repository's Apache-2.0 license.
